levels.title: Year 1 – Basics
levels.subtitle: DC circuits & digital logic
levels.description: The foundations: electrical quantities, Ohm's and Kirchhoff's laws, circuit-analysis techniques and digital logic.

levels.title: Year 1 – Advanced
levels.subtitle: Transients, AC, filters & electronics
levels.description: Capacitors and inductors, transients, AC analysis, frequency response, semiconductor devices and op amps.

levels.title: Year 2 – Basics
levels.subtitle: Signals, fields, magnetics & digital systems
levels.description: Signals and systems, electromagnetic fields, magnetic circuits and transformers, and digital systems with microcontrollers.

levels.title: Year 2 – Advanced
levels.subtitle: Transforms, control, machines & measurement
levels.description: Fourier and Laplace transforms, control systems, electric machines and power, instrumentation and measurement.

levels.title: Year 3 – Basics
levels.subtitle: Discrete time, analog design, EMC & communication
levels.description: Discrete-time signals and the z-transform, practical analog circuit design, electromagnetic compatibility, and electronic communication systems: modulation, receivers, transmission lines, antennas and digital links.

levels.title: Year 3 – Advanced
levels.subtitle: Power, DSP, control, probability, RF & devices
levels.description: Power electronics and power systems, digital signal processing, state-space and digital control, probability and random signals, RF and microwave circuits, semiconductor device physics, and information theory and coding.
